adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, which does `usernames.split(",").each` and then performs `User.find_by_username(username)` and `group.add(user)` per entry, with no max length/entry cap or whitespace normalization (no `strip`). This makes the request cost unbounded based on attacker-controlled input and also causes padded usernames like " bob" to fail lookup and be silently skipped (`find_by_username` won’t match). Both behaviors are directly visible in the added method.
